GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat last 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well without threatening # ok from last

Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths turning, Hooked Out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: raced keenly approaching/rounding first turn.] # ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly approaching and rounding the first turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths turning, pocketed rounding turn, steered into cutaway and hit Lead 220m, kept going to posty # solid win

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down Made Ground 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 600m, Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted wider again Straightening Up and Made Ground to the line # ran on okay
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Approaching the 1200m was steadied outwards after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved only marginally in straight. [Stewards: Inclined to pull in the middle stages.] # never a threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to pull in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Hampered 1 length at the start, Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 6 Lengths 3 Wide , shifted Six Wide Straightening Up and ran on hitting the Lead at the 60m, kept going to post # ran on well
Jumped Ok Settled Down 8th 6 Lengths 1200m 9th 8 Lengths 800m 9th 7 Lengths home turn 8th Hooked Out 3 Wide 6 Lengths widest Straight to only hold ground # one paced run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr: travelled comfortably throughout the early and middle stages. When placed under pressure approaching the home turn, was disappointing in the manner it responded and failed to quicken as well as anticipated. After balancing up in the straight, responded fairly but only ground its way to the line and did not quicken significantly. The rider added that the gelding may not have been comfortable lengthening stride on the shifting track conditions, which were chopping out significantly rounding the bend. Post race vet no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 4 lengths. moved up 4 Wide turn joining leaders. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide & without cover majority of event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . held Inside Position 5th 4 Lengths @ 1000m. cut corner then gradually got wider and wider to Best Going in Straight but but was always going too well # comfy win this

Debut for stable. jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced well back on inside (8L from lead). Stayed well back on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 500m. Chasing Five Wide on home turn (8L from lead). Worked home fairly without threatening in straight. # Last 150m OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated that his mount settled worse than midfield behind a strongly tempo in the early and middle stages. Rdr stated his mount ground its way to the line down the straight but was unable to make the required ground on the leading division. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, railed to 3 Lengths turning, steered 2 lanes short of centre of track Straightening Up , steered wider down the running, challenged for the lead inside the 150m and kept battling to post # battled on ok
Slow Out 3 lengths Settled Down last 8 lengths. well back turn. hooked Wide in Straight . ran on well # start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin (2L). Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.
